svg.title: Lion and stag heraldic emblem — reconstructed vector artwork
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied PNG. Shield and ribbon geometry rebuilt as editable paths; animal and crown linework isolated and fitted as Bezier paths with a reduced colour palette. Original motto letterforms are outlined. All artwork is vector; no embedded raster or font dependency. Background is transparent. Print grain has been reduced while engraved markings are retained.
